description:
GridPlayer application


The biggest update yet: a new video engine, new ways to lay out videos, lists in a cell, subtitles, and many fixes.
Before you update
- Supported systems: 64-bit Windows 10 (1809 or later) and 11, macOS 14 or later, and Linux with glibc 2.34 or newer
  for the AppImage (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, RHEL 9). Installed with pip, it needs Python 3.11 or later. On 32-bit
  Windows, older macOS or older Linux, stay on 0.5.5.
- Playlists saved by 0.6.0 don't open in 0.5.x. Older playlists open fine in 0.6.0. Keep a copy if you might go back.
- MPV is now the default player. VLC is still there: Settings > Advanced > Video Decoder.
What's new
- MPV player: Hardware and Software decoding, with all videos in one process. Pick fast or exact seeking, picture
  quality, and your own mpv.conf. It can skip frames to play more videos at once.
- Grid modes:
  - Fixed Grid with big cells and templates, Free Tiles placed by hand, and Mosaic, which arranges itself around locked
    tiles.
  - Auto grid by the videos' shapes.
  - Drag the lines between cells to resize them.
  - In Single Mode, a strip keeps the other videos playing.
- Lists in a cell: m3u, pls and xspf playlists, folders, YouTube playlists and IPTV channels.
- Subtitles: track choice, subtitle files, encoding and style.
- Audio: extra audio tracks from files, audio delay, the output device for each video, and a preferred language.
- Chapters, including YouTube's, bookmarks, and SponsorBlock with segment markers and auto skip.
- Sync zoom and position, play/pause and speed between videos.
- Zoom to the cursor or to a selection, aspect ratio and crop presets as in VLC, screenshots, and moving the picture
  in its cell.
- When finished: loop, play the next, previous or a random file (subfolders too), pause, stop or close.
- Streams: proxy, cookies from your browser, user agent and TLS settings, and Auto, Best or Audio only quality.
- Redesigned Settings (with search), the Playlist window, overlay, tooltips and error messages.
- New shortcuts editor for keys and mouse, a tray icon, media keys, and Reopen Closed Video.
- New packages for Windows on ARM and Linux on ARM (AppImage).
- Qt 6: sharper windows at 125% and 150% on Wayland.
- Translations: text not yet translated by people is filled in with AI translations. The language list shows how
  much of each language people have checked.
The full list is in the changelog.
Thanks to everyone whose code is in this release

And to everyone who translated, reported bugs and suggested features.
